name: ARWP Site Execution Manifest
purpose: Define how a site-wide ARWP application composes existing audit domains, specialist skills, applicability decisions, verification and repair without creating one Agent Skill per individual check.
principles: A check is not a skill boundary.
The orchestrator owns whole-site coverage, applicability, sequencing, evidence reconciliation and completion.
Specialist skills own reusable expert workflows with distinct evidence, inputs or verification logic.
Audit-domain checks remain in their canonical registries and are referenced by module ID instead of copied into this manifest.
Every applicable module must end in explicit evidence and state; omission is not equivalent to not-applicable.
Repository, build, deployed HTTP, rendered runtime and owner-platform evidence remain separate.
Surface Integrity is the mandatory cross-module reconciliation pass before a full completion claim.

invokeSpecialistWhen: canonical/generated ownership is unclear
repository entropy materially raises inspection or change risk
large transformation changed navigation or source/output boundaries
public hostname release/readiness is in scope
ordinary technical checks are green but Search presentation may still be false-green
canonical/redirect/pagination/head behavior needs adversarial review
article/docs/comparison/answer quality is material
generated/data/knowledge pages are candidates for broad Search-facing publication
multi-page site needs canonical crawl-path evidence
orphan/dead-end/breadcrumb/semantic-relation risk is material
meaningful images are part of Search/Images/Discover intent
image-heavy pages have delivery, responsive, attribution or sitemap questions
more than one locale exists
a change affects localizable UI/content/Search/agent surfaces
locale parity or source staleness needs verification
Search/AI outcomes or provider-native baselines are part of the task
owner analytics/Search Console/Bing/referral evidence is available
the site exposes or should expose truthful agent/API/protocol discovery
the site publishes real subscribable updates that justify RSS/Atom/JSON Feed handling
important surfaces need assertion/CI/receipt protection
change provenance or blast radius must be traced across source, recommendation and transformation

conditionalPacks.rule: Evaluate every pack trigger during applicability. Activated packs contribute checks/evidence to their owning modules; they do not create new skills automatically.

createNewSkillOnlyWhen: the capability is a reusable multi-step workflow rather than one check
it has distinct inputs, evidence semantics or verification/rollback logic
it benefits from scoped references/scripts/tests that would overload the orchestrator
it can be invoked independently across more than one site or module context
doNotCreateSkillFor: one provider recommendation that belongs in an existing domain or practice registry
skillPolicy.compositionRule: Prefer adding or refining a check in its canonical registry, then map it through an existing module. Add a module only when execution/evidence boundaries differ materially. Add a skill only when the reusable workflow itself is a product boundary.

fullClaimRules: unknown applicability is resolved or the overall coverage state remains partial/unknown
every activated conditional pack is represented in evidence
not-applicable always has an explicit reason
specialist output contributes evidence to the module rather than replacing whole-site coverage

repeatWhen: verification exposes new affected routes or representations
cross-module parity is blocked and the cause is safely repairable
stopWhen: remaining work requires owner facts/credentials/external platform evidence
the proposed fix is materially uncertain or irreversible
all required resolvable states pass and Surface Integrity is not blocked

requires: coverage state from the comprehensive audit contract
page ledger or equivalent durable coverage evidence
verification evidence for changed and affected surfaces
tested repository revision and deployment identity when available
forbids: treating bounded specialist output as whole-site proof
creating a specialist skill merely to avoid maintaining the module/check registries
one composite quality/SEO/AI/accessibility/security score as a substitute for evidence
